text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Satsuki Sho, the first race 
towards claiming the "Triple Crown," has 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Right before the race, Tokai Teio was 
unusually nervous and couldn't keep her 
composure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Relieved of her tension thanks to the 
Trainer's advice, she headed into the race 
determined to run with all her might and 
surprise everyone.
